cases.name: calendar_current
cases.html:
Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Show "In a meeting" beside your name while your Google Calendar says you're busy. Only free/busy times are read — never titles or attendees. A custom status or DND shows instead.

Show when I'm in a meeting
Connected as fixture<&>@example.test.
Out of office

Out of office until March 04, 2026 from your Google Calendar.

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Use out-of-office events from your Google Calendar: they mark you out for the event's span. Only the event type and times are read — never titles or details. When both apply, the later end shows; clearing above ends only the manual one.

Use my Google Calendar out-of-office
Connected as fixture<&>@example.test.
